component.name: Deck Video Player
component.summary: Controller-friendly HDR video player for Steam Deck and SteamOS

description.p: A lightweight video player built on mpv, designed for the SteamOS game mode: browse your video folders and control playback entirely with the Steam Deck controls.
Beta software: so far it has only been lightly tested on a Steam Deck OLED, a Steam Deck LCD and a PC running SteamOS, and comes without any warranty.

ul.li: Plays virtually every video format, with hardware decoding
Real HDR output under gamescope (Steam Deck OLED, HDR TVs)
Matches the Steam Deck refresh rate to the video frame rate
Audio and subtitle track selection, resume playback
Headphone surround: 5.1/7.1 soundtracks as 3D sound on headphones
Subtitle downloads from OpenSubtitles.com (free personal API key)
Plex and Jellyfin streaming with progress sync (sign in with a QR code)
Recently played list, black-bar cropping, screen kept awake while playing
Night mode, and intro/credits skipping for Plex and Jellyfin
Video info for every file, and HDR settings (HDR off, tone mapping, SDR to HDR)

screenshot.caption: Library with watched marks and resume progress

description.p: Jellyfin, and where each video comes from.

ul.li: Jellyfin servers: found on the home network, Quick Connect sign-in with a QR code, Continue watching, Next up, libraries, direct play with progress and watched sync
Recently played and Video info show where each video is: local folder, SD card, USB drive, Plex or Jellyfin
Subtitle brightness in the playback menu
Headphone surround places the 5.1 surround channels behind the listener
Signing in to a server from the only folder shows the start screen

description.p: HDR mapping per scene only where it applies.

ul.li: "Display, per scene" is offered only for Dolby Vision and HDR10+ videos, which have scene-by-scene information

description.p: Video info, HDR settings, and Plex in Recently played.

ul.li: Video info in the library: codec, bitrate, HDR type, audio and subtitle tracks, location
Video menu with picture, refresh rate and HDR settings: HDR off, who tone-maps HDR, SDR to HDR
Plex videos in Recently played, and Remove from Continue watching
Picture mode no longer gets stuck after "No black bars found"

description.p: Better sound, and intro and credits skipping for Plex.

ul.li: Night mode: evens out loud and quiet passages on speakers, headphones and TVs
Skip intro, skip credits and next episode with R2 on Plex videos that have markers
Headphone surround sounds fuller and as loud as normal playback, with the subwoofer channel
Holding L2 or R2 no longer skips several chapters
Plex auto-play continues after an episode fails, and stops at once when the server can't be reached
Crop black bars no longer crops dark scene edges, and retries after a miss
B closes Advanced statistics; the Subtitles menu shows new downloads right away
Sturdier keep-awake, less battery use while paused, instant sorting of Plex libraries

description.p: When the installer can't repair the Steam shortcut because Steam is open, it says so at the end and explains the remaining step.
The installer repairs Steam shortcuts that named the old Flatpak branch, which made the app return to Steam immediately after updating to 0.3.3.
Updating no longer leaves the previous version running: releases use the same Flatpak branch as test builds, and the installer removes other installed copies.
The screen no longer dims and the system no longer sleeps while a video plays (not while paused).
Fixes and a small addition from testing on a Steam Deck.

ul.li: Recently played videos on the start screen
Crop black bars stored in the video (e.g. 4:3 shows saved as 16:9)
B hides the playback controls first, and stops only when nothing is shown
Mark as watched for partly watched videos, including Plex

description.p: Plex streaming, and a security review of the account and network code.

ul.li: Sign in to Plex with a QR code or a link code; servers appear as library sources
Direct play from Plex with HDR, hardware decoding and refresh-rate matching
Progress and watched state synced with the Plex server
Subtitle downloads for Plex videos
Narrower sandbox: Videos, Downloads and removable drives only
R1 +60 s shown in the hint bar

description.p: Better audio and subtitles, and fixes from the first tests on a Steam Deck.

ul.li: Headphone surround for 5.1 and 7.1 audio (audio menu)
Download subtitles from OpenSubtitles.com (subtitle menu)
Refresh-rate matching works on current SteamOS, with an on/off toggle
SD card and USB drives shown by name, with icons
Long names scroll instead of overflowing; About panel
Audio/subtitle choices and delays no longer carry over to the next video
